notes.title: Kickstarter!!!
notes.content:
[h1][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/weneedbees/investi-gator-and-the-case-of-the-big-crime]Investi-Gator is being Kickstarter'd right now![/url][/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34660467/b44cffebe8e8d6d49aa21105f69f1a73fa522f29.png[/img]

We've hit our initial goal and are all set to release in Spring 2019, but there's plenty of stretch goals that we're still trying for!  Please [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/weneedbees/investi-gator-and-the-case-of-the-big-crime]check it out![/url]

Backing the Kickstarter will also net you a Steam key, so now's a great time to support us!
